title: Qwen3.8-27B GSQ-RCO IQ3_XXS (10.1 GB) on stock llama.cpp
slug_note: ISTA DASLab's mixed-precision 3-bit GGUF: matches BF16 on AIME25 at 10.1 GB; the 12 GB card pick of one tester.

variation.quant_detail: GSQ-RCO IQ3_XXS, 3.00 bits/weight, 10.1 GB. Other files: IQ2_XS 8.4 GB, IQ2_S 9.3 GB, IQ3_S 11.8 GB; each also as -mtp (+0.35 GB).

engine.config: stock llama.cpp, all layers on GPU

requirements.notes: Estimate: 10.1 GB file plus KV headroom. Tight on a 12 GB card; use IQ2_S (9.3 GB) or IQ2_XS (8.4 GB) for longer context.

steps.text: Install llama.cpp (see Step 0 in Quick start).
The card's command is a one-shot prompt. To serve an API, run llama-server with the same -m file and -ngl 99.

caveats: Card accuracy (vs BF16): IQ3_XXS 100.00 AIME25 / 88.89 GPQA-Diamond / 84.57 LiveCodeBench v6, against 100.00 / 89.90 / 85.71. IQ3_S (11.8 GB) is the card's 'task-lossless' pick.

A 12 GB tester scored 'Qwen3.8-27B GSQ-RCO' 16/20 on a 20-task agentic coding test (PatchEval), best of the 27B quants he tried, but did not say which file (https://x.com/DogukanUrker/status/2109207879571927068).
